meaning:
παρ-ακοή, -ῆς, ἡ
1. a hearing amiss (Flat.)
2. Later, as following inattention, disobedience: Rom.5:19, 2Co.10:6, Heb.2:2 (cf. παρακούω, and see Tr., Syn., § lxvi).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
